svg.title: Setpoint weighting on the heater
svg.desc: With set B, a 3 degree Celsius setpoint step makes the heater command jump to 92.7 percent with weight 1, 89.2 percent with 0.8 and 80.6 percent with 0.3. The smaller weights arrive later: with 0.3 the water is still 0.37 degrees low at 15 seconds.
svg.text: Setpoint weighting on the heater with set B
Control Studio validation runs of this project · 3 °C setpoint step · Kp 5.79, Ki 1.14 · numbers answer the predictions
